stories.title: 'Lightning in a bottle': Inside the booming world of Circa and NFL survivor pools
stories.summary: In the heart of Las Vegas, bettors try to do the unthinkable: turn $1,000 into $20 million throughout the NFL season.

stories.title: Engelbert retiring as WNBA commish after season
stories.summary: WNBA commissioner Cathy Engelbert, who oversaw massive growth in the league while also facing recent scrutiny in her handling of multiple issues, will retire at the end of the year.

stories.title: Simmons reaches 1-year, $3.5M deal with Kings
stories.summary: Ben Simmons is back in the NBA after reaching one-year, $3.5 million deal with the Kings, his agents Max Wiepking, Sean Tribe and Ryan Arney told Andscape and ESPN.

stories.title: Clark, Howard lead U.S. over China in WC opener
stories.summary: Caitlin Clark and Rhyne Howard had 14 points each in the United States' 33-point win over China to open women's basketball World Cup play.

stories.title: Pro Football HOF overhauling selection process
stories.summary: The Pro Football Hall of Fame has made sweeping changes to its selection process that include a significant reduction in the number of selectors and the elimination of the separate Seniors category.
